links.outcome: Consistency of ChatGPT responses across two rounds of the same CRRT alarm questions
links.effect: ChatGPT-3.5 agreement between rounds 84% (Kappa 0.78); ChatGPT-4 agreement 92% (Kappa 0.88); difference not statistically significant.
links.quote: The agreement between the first and second rounds of ChatGPT-3.5 was 84% with a Kappa statistic of 0.78, while the agreement of ChatGPT-4 was 92% with a Kappa statistic of 0.88.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and consistency of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 on a set of 50 CRRT alarm troubleshooting queries without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
